in_force: yes, from 10 Jul 2026; the 29/2023 deadline of 1 Jan 2026 carried over
what_it_says: Pre-packaged foods must declare energy, protein, carbohydrate, fat and sodium per 100 g, 100 ml, serving or pack; percentage of the 50 g protein reference value optional; stock labelled before 1 Jan 2026 may be sold to expiry; tolerances per Decree 37/2026 Art 49(1)
what_it_does_not_say: No conditions for nutrient content or health claims; exempts single-ingredient foods and foods made by small food businesses
notes: Read as extracts. Wet-market and household chay makers are exempt as small food businesses (our reading of Art 1(2)(m)).

what_it_says: Protein source claim at 10% of NRV per 100 g (solids) or 5% per 100 kcal or 10% per serving; high (cao) claim at twice source; comparative claims need 25% difference; claims require a nutrition panel; health claims need acceptance by the national authority
what_it_does_not_say: No per 100 ml protein condition and no synonym list seen in extracts; not referenced by any MOH circular we read
notes: With the 50 g protein NRV: source 5 g and high 10 g per 100 g; 2.5 g and 5 g per 100 kcal (our calculation).

what_it_says: NRV-R protein 50 g for the general population over 36 months; points to TCVN 14429:2025 for claims
what_it_does_not_say: Not a claim rule itself
notes: Same 50 g value as Appendix II of Circular 30/2026.

what_it_says: Claims for added vitamins, minerals, amino acids and similar only at 10% RNI or more; health claims need 10% RNI and specific scientific evidence
what_it_does_not_say: Protein is not named; no approval route for health claims on ordinary foods
notes: Supports avoiding function claims such as builds muscle on chay foods (our reading).

instrument: Decree 37/2026/ND-CP (replaced Decree 43/2017 and Decree 111/2021 on goods labels)
in_force: yes, from 23 Jan 2026; transition in Art 98
topic: goods labels: truthfulness, product name, quantitative ingredients, GM wording
what_it_says: Carries the Decree 43/2017 rules: labels truthful and reflecting the true nature of goods; name must not mislead about nature, use or composition; an ingredient named in the product name must be quantified; GM ingredients marked biến đổi gen beside the ingredient name with its content
what_it_does_not_say: No reserved names for meat, milk or cheese; no definition of chay; no allergen list (package S9.7)
notes: Decree 43/2017 wording read in full extracts; its carry-over into Decree 37/2026 rests on exact-phrase index matches and a customs letter, not a read of chapter IV.

in_force: yes (Resolution 15/2026 keeps it until the new law)
what_it_says: Processed pre-packaged foods, including supplemented foods, are self-declared; registration only for health supplements, medical and special-diet foods, products for children to 36 months and some additives; GM information on the label when a GM ingredient is more than 5% of total ingredients; advertising content confirmation only for the registered categories
what_it_does_not_say: No link between a nutrient claim and registration
notes: A protein claim on a chay food triggers neither registration nor advertising confirmation (our reading).

what_it_says: Applies above 5% GM ingredient; not to GM food in which neither the modified gene nor its product can be detected, nor to fresh or unpackaged GM food; wording biến đổi gen beside the ingredient name
what_it_does_not_say: Does not say whether a recombinant protein identical to a native protein counts as a detectable product of the modified gene
notes: Issued under the pre-2017 label decree; still listed in force.

topic: product standard (giò, chả, xúc xích and other cooked meat products)
what_it_says: Main material chilled or frozen meat; optional seasonings; limits on ammonia, peroxide, benzo(a)pyrene and microbes
what_it_does_not_say: No minimum meat or protein content; no limit on or naming duty for added plant protein

instrument: TCVN 7050:2020 processed meat not heat treated
topic: product standard (ready-to-eat products not cooked above 70 C)
what_it_says: Main material meat; optional seasonings; ammonia and peroxide limits
what_it_does_not_say: No minimum meat content; plant proteins not mentioned

topic: product standard (canned meat, pate in cans)
what_it_says: The maker self-declares the meat share by weight
what_it_does_not_say: No minimum meat content

what_it_says: Defines meat and meat product
what_it_does_not_say: No term for meat analogue, extender or meat content seen

topic: definition of vegetarian (chay) and vegan (thuần chay) claims
what_it_says: Vegetarian allows egg, milk (lacto types), honey and bee products; vegan excludes all animal-derived inputs; GMP against unintended presence; claim terms beside the trade name
what_it_does_not_say: No allium rule; no Buddhist sense of chay; no DNA test method; not referenced by any regulation we found
notes: One extract lists sản phẩm chay among the covered label terms; CHY-57 confirms.

what_it_says: The name sữa đậu nành requires at least 2.0 g protein per 100 ml; lower-protein products are soybean drinks
what_it_does_not_say: Nothing on nut, oat or rice drinks
notes: Vinasoy declares Fami against it; Fami Canxi sits at 2.0 g (FTR-19).

instrument: TCVN 11216:2015 milk and milk products vocabulary
what_it_says: Milk is a mammary secretion
what_it_does_not_say: No Codex STAN 206 style restriction on dairy terms for non-dairy products
notes: Re-read in this line for the restriction clause.

topic: dairy composition and principal-label type statement
what_it_says: Fresh milk groups at least 90% raw milk; principal label states the product type; reconstituted, recombined and composite milk named in capitals
what_it_does_not_say: No mention of plant drinks; does not reserve sữa
notes: Whether it replaces QCVN 5-1:2010/BYT was not stated in the text read.

what_it_says: Bans untruthful or misleading ads and unproven comparisons; food ads need a declared product; endorsers must check product documents
what_it_does_not_say: No claim thresholds

what_it_says: Food ads carry the product name and responsible firm; health supplement and infant rules
what_it_does_not_say: No content confirmation for ordinary foods found

what_it_says: Fines for products not matching declared information (Art 22) and for GM food breaches (Art 17)
what_it_does_not_say: Label-specific articles not seen

in_force: no; National Assembly session from Oct 2026
what_it_says: Two product groups; registration limited to medical, special-diet, infant and supplement products; bans advertising of medical nutrition and infant products
what_it_does_not_say: No claim, chay or naming provisions in the Government press read by the package
notes: Package sources; draft text not read.

what_it_does_not_say: Not a naming rule
